subject.title: fix(codex): wait for turn completion after post-tool handoff

question: After a Codex tool handoff, should OpenClaw retain any bounded fallback that releases a genuine completed final assistant item when turn/completed is missing, or require the typed turn terminal event unconditionally?
rationale: Codex defines turn/completed as the terminal signal, but OpenClaw has shipped defensive fallback behavior for malformed streams; choosing strict fail-closed semantics can intentionally convert previously returned final text into a timeout.

options.title: Preserve a narrow fallback
options.body: Rebase onto current main and suppress only commentary or intermediate progress while retaining the bounded genuine-final fallback and testing both paths.

options.title: Adopt strict turn completion
options.body: Rebase the PR and explicitly accept that every post-tool stream missing turn/completed must wait or time out even when it contains final assistant text.

options.title: Pause this change
options.body: Leave current-main behavior unchanged until a reliable protocol signal can distinguish post-tool progress from genuine final output.

recommendation.title: Preserve a narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and suppress only commentary or intermediate progress while retaining the bounded genuine-final fallback and testing both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history in the exact Codex terminal-outcome and completion-watch boundary and is routed the latest maintainer attention in the supplied timeline.
